shopify.title: Connect
shopify.intro: Connect your Shopify store so order, fulfilment, refund, and cart events automatically trigger WhatsApp messages — and the dashboard shows your order, product and customer counts.
shopify.help: Webhooks are auto-installed after connecting — no manual steps. Stuck on credentials?
shopify.disabledBody: An administrator needs to add the Shopify app credentials before any workspace can connect a store. Once that's done, the form below will activate.
shopify.urlHint: Just the store handle — or paste the full URL, we'll normalise it.
shopify.guide1: We redirect you to Shopify to authorize the requested scopes.
shopify.guide2: Shopify sends us back a permanent access token signed with HMAC.
shopify.guide3: Webhooks for {count} events get auto-registered against your store.
shopify.guide4: You land back here to map each event to a WhatsApp template.
shopify.failed: Could not start the connection to Shopify.

woocommerce.title: Connect
woocommerce.intro: Pull WooCommerce orders, refunds, products, and customer events into chat threads. Confirm orders, ship updates, and recover carts on WhatsApp without leaving the CRM.
woocommerce.step2: Generate API keys in WC admin
woocommerce.help: Webhooks auto-install after you connect — no manual steps inside WC. Stuck on the keys?
woocommerce.disabledBody: An administrator must enable the WooCommerce integration before any workspace can connect a store.
woocommerce.urlHint: HTTPS required for Basic Auth. We'll detect WP REST automatically.
woocommerce.secretHint: Stored encrypted at rest. Only used to call your store's REST API.
woocommerce.g1: Open WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
woocommerce.g2: Click Add key. Give it a description like "CRM".
woocommerce.g3: Pick a user (admin works) and set Permissions = Read/Write.
woocommerce.g4: Click Generate API key. Copy both keys — the secret is only shown once.
woocommerce.g5: Paste them in the form on the left and click Test connection.
woocommerce.httpsBody: Basic Auth requires HTTPS. If your store is HTTP-only, install an SSL certificate first (Let's Encrypt is free).

lifecycle.name: Order lifecycle
lifecycle.desc: Transactional updates — fire automatically on store events.

orders_create.name: Order confirmation
orders_create.desc: Thank the customer the moment they place an order.

orders_fulfilled.name: Shipped / Out for delivery
orders_fulfilled.desc: Send a dispatch note — use '{{'tracking_url'}}' for the live tracking link.

order_delivered.name: Delivered
order_delivered.desc: Confirm delivery (asks for a review if your template does). Fires when the courier marks it delivered.

orders_cancelled.name: Order cancelled
orders_cancelled.desc: Let the customer know an order was cancelled.

refunds_create.name: Refund issued
refunds_create.desc: Confirm a refund has been processed.

orders_updated.name: Order updated
orders_updated.desc: Fire on any change to an existing order.

checkouts_create.name: Abandoned cart · step 1
checkouts_create.desc: Fires right after a checkout is abandoned — include '{{'checkout_url'}}' to bring them back.

cart_step2.name: Abandoned cart · step 2
cart_step2.desc: Scheduled follow-up (set the delay, e.g. 1 hour). Auto-cancels if they buy.

cart_step3.name: Abandoned cart · step 3
cart_step3.desc: Final nudge (e.g. 24 hours) — add a coupon in the template to close the sale.

cod_confirm.name: COD order confirmation
cod_confirm.desc: Ask cash-on-delivery customers to confirm with a Yes/No reply — cuts fake orders & returns (RTO).

cod_prepaid.name: COD → Prepaid offer
cod_prepaid.desc: Nudge COD customers to pay online now (use '{{'order_url'}}' + a discount in the template) — fewer returns, faster cash.

stock_back.name: Back-in-stock alert
stock_back.desc: Customers who message about a sold-out item get notified automatically when it is restocked.

customers_update.name: Customer updated
customers_update.desc: Fire when a customer profile changes.

products_update.name: Product updated
products_update.desc: Internal trigger on price / stock change.

order_created.name: Order placed
order_created.desc: Sent the moment a new order comes in.

order_processing.name: Order confirmed
order_processing.desc: Payment received — the order is being prepared.

order_on_hold.name: Order on hold
order_on_hold.desc: Awaiting payment or stock — keep the buyer informed.

cod_confirm.name: COD double-confirmation
cod_confirm.desc: Ask cash-on-delivery buyers to confirm Yes / No before you ship — the #1 way to cut RTO.

cod_prepaid.name: COD → Prepaid nudge
cod_prepaid.desc: Offer COD buyers a pay-online link (template can carry '{{'order_url'}}' + an incentive).

checkout_created.name: Abandoned cart · step 1
checkout_created.desc: First nudge when checkout starts but no order lands. Needs the companion WooCommerce plugin.

cart_step2.name: Abandoned cart · step 2
cart_step2.desc: Scheduled follow-up after the delay below.

cart_step3.name: Abandoned cart · step 3
cart_step3.desc: Final reminder — add a discount in the template.

stock_back.name: Back in stock
stock_back.desc: Message everyone on the waitlist when a sold-out product is restocked.

subscription_payment_failed.name: Subscription dunning
subscription_payment_failed.desc: When a subscription renewal payment fails, send a one-tap "update payment" link. Needs the companion WooCommerce plugin.

customer_created.name: Welcome new customer
customer_created.desc: Greet a customer the first time they register on the store.

review_reward.name: Review-gated coupon
review_reward.desc: When a recent buyer replies with a positive rating (4–5 / "great"), auto-send this reward template — put a coupon in it. Pair it with an "Order delivered" template that asks them to rate.

plugin.title: WordPress plugin
plugin.body: Install this small plugin on your store to recover abandoned carts before an order exists, and to pass on failed subscription payments and custom order statuses.
plugin.step1: Download the plugin below. It is made for this store.
plugin.step2: In WordPress, open Plugins, Add New, Upload Plugin, choose the zip and activate it.
plugin.step3: Make sure WP-Cron runs on your site. The plugin checks for idle carts every 5 minutes.
plugin.secretNote: The file holds this store's secret key. Keep it private.
